errors.text_span: Die horizontale Achse identifiziert die Länder Aluminium, Kupfer und Nickel
errors.evidence: The horizontal axis does not identify countries; it identifies industrial raw materials (Aluminium, Kupfer, Nickel).

errors.text_span: Der Balken für Aluminium beginnt bei 0 % und erreicht im Jahr 2022 5 % bevor er im Jahr 2023 auf 2,8 % abnimmt.
errors.evidence: The values for Aluminium in 2022 and 2023 are incorrect. For Germany, the values are 2.7% (2022) and 1.0% (2023), and for the EU, they are 2.8% (2022) and 1.7% (2023).

errors.text_span: Der Balken für Kupfer beginnt bei 0 % und erreicht im Jahr 2022 2,2 % bevor er im Jahr 2023 bei 1,3 % abnimmt.
errors.evidence: The values for Kupfer in 2022 and 2023 are incorrect. For Germany, the values are 11.3% (2022) and 2.2% (2023), and for the EU, they are 5.1% (2022) and 1.3% (2023).

errors.text_span: Der Balken für Nickel beginnt bei 0 % und erreicht im Jahr 2022 2,2 % bevor er im Jahr 2023 bei 1,7 % abnimmt.
errors.evidence: The values for Nickel in 2022 and 2023 are incorrect. For Germany, the values are 24.7% (2022) and 11.4% (2023), and for the EU, they are 23.3% (2022) and 14.6% (2023).
The description does not mention that the chart shows the share of Russian imports of selected industrial raw materials in percentage terms.
The description does not mention that the chart consists of two separate bar charts, one for Germany and one for the EU.
The description does not mention the color coding of the bars: blue for 2021, violet for 2022, and gray for 2023.
The description does not mention the range of the vertical axis (0 to 30%) or the tick intervals (5%).
